title: Foiled attempt to ATT&CK technique link
description: One attempt (#25) to ATT&CK technique link produced by the rules in rules/attack/ (#26). Scored by the confidence layer (#27), shown as a technique chip (#14) and exported as a STIX attack-pattern relationship (#13). Mirrored by foiled_core::attack::AttemptTechniqueLink. See docs/attack-mapping.md.

attack_version.description: The pinned ATT&CK version the ids come from (data/attack/VERSION).

technique_id.description: Official ATT&CK technique id, never a sub-technique.

subtechnique_id.description: Official sub-technique id when the rule named one. Its prefix equals technique_id.

confidence_ref.description: Id of the confidence record (#27) once the link has been scored.
